{{Quote|Part of the Death Star design team is on their way to a rendezvous with the Star Destroyer ''Immortal''.|Admiral Gial Ackbar leads a Rebel briefing|<ref name="XW" />}}
'''''Immortal''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II-class Star Destroyer'']] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]].

==History==
During the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Immortal'' was assigned to take out the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. It [[Death Star plans delivery|ambushed]] the ''Tantive IV'' while she was receiving the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] plans from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Maria (Lambda-class)|''Maria'']], launching several [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] to disable the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] before jumping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Immortal'' was due to return and deliver a shuttle carrying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to capture the vessel after the Gunboats disabled it, however Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], led by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], were able to destroy the Gunboats and allow the ''Tantive IV'' to escape.

Just hours later, while the ''Tantive IV'' was about to deliver the plans to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], the ''Immortal'' once again showed up and [[Assault on the Tantive IV|prevented]] the transfer, this time succeeding in disrupting [[Operation Skyhook]]. Keyan Farlander and [[Hamo Blastwell]] in [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]] held off the Imperial attack while the ''Tantive IV'' escaped. The ''Tantive IV'' then proceeded to 'plan B' and moved to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, once there, it was intercepted by the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].

The ''Immortal'' led several attacks on Rebel Alliance freighters and cruisers shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. When [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], acting on behalf of the Rebels, [[Capture of the Sidral II|captured]] the Imperial [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Sidral II]]'' the ''Immortal'' attempted to prevent the transfer of its cargo of military equipment bound for the Death Star to the Rebel corvette ''[[Frazier]]''. The ''Immortal'' was some distance away but launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. However, two [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], led by Keyan Farlander, prevented the TIEs from disrupting the transfer and the Rebels fled to hyperspace safely.

When the Rebels disabled an Imperial [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] carrying officers headed for the Death Star, the ''Immortal'' attempted to prevent the shuttle [[Hunter (Lambda-class)|''Hunter'']] from capturing the transport. However, by the time it arrived the transport had already been captured and was headed for the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Inad (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Inad'']]. While fighters launched from the ''Immortal'' [[Capture of the Omicron 1|engaged]] Rebel [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], more Imperial transports attempted to recapture the stolen transport. However, Farlander again destroyed the transports and the Rebels escaped.

During another mission it [[Attack on the Defiance|approached]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] above [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] and launched squadrons of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to destroy it. Most of the ''Defiance's'' pilots were away flying other missions but the ship was able to scramble three X-wings and two R-22 Spearheads in its defense. The Rebel pilots, including Farlander and [[Breth Gart]], on temporary assignment from the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], were able to tarry them, until the ''Defiance'' hyperspaced away. Same happened with ''Independence'' as soon as the Death Star was completed.

The officers who had been previously captured by the Rebels were unable to reveal much information except that [[Bevel Lemelisk]] was leading the design team and that some of his team had recently traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a meeting with [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. As the technicians left Coruscant on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Godar]]'' bound for the ''Intrepid'', the Rebels [[Capture of the Death Star design team|attacked]] with a Y-wing from Red Squadron, flown by Farlander, two X-wings from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] ''[[Rescue 1 (Lambda-class)|Rescue 1]]''. The ''Immortal'' launched TIEs to assist the escorting Assault Gunboats, but the Rebel fighters were able to hold off the Imperials while Farlander disabled the ''Godar'' and ''Rescue 1'' conducted the boarding operation. After ''Rescue 1'' captured the personnel and fled into hyperspace, Farlander destroyed the ''Godar'' before following the other Rebels.

Later the ''Immortal'' [[Attack on the Independence|attacked]] the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]] as part of a major Imperial offensive after the completion of the Death Star. The Imperial attack consisted of TIE Bombers to attack the cruiser while Assault Gunboats and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] engaged the defending X-wings and R-22s. Despite splitting up and attacking from three different directions two of the Imperial bomber groups were quickly destroyed. The third made it through and began firing [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the ''Independence''. The defending starfighters were caught up fighting the Gunboats but eventually broke away and were able to help the ''Independence's'' gunners destroy the last bombers. The ''Independence'' escaped to hyperspace with its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] down but with only minimal hull damage.

[[File:Fleet_massing_near_Sullust_XWA.png|thumb|right|250px|''Immortal'' approaching the [[Independence task force|''Independence'' task force]] during the [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|Battle of Sullust]].]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the ''Immortal'' [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|attacked]] the ''Defiance'' and the ''Independence'' to prevent them to reach the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] and the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] preparing the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="XwA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The book ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' informs us that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was onboard the ship while chasing ''Tantive IV''. It's possible that the game authors were ignorant of the canon and ''Immortal'' was a mistaken made-up name for the canonical ship [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] that appeared in the movie.
